mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 84 degrees with clear skies and a full moon visible at Harriet Park, alongside an air quality index of 58.

City officials have announced that the intersection of Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive will be closed from August 5 to 7 for sewer and water work. Also, don't forget to vote for the best student-designed I Voted stickers through August 7.
There is plenty to do in Verona, with trivia at The Bogey Factory and the Downtown Farmers Market happening today, plus live music and concerts at Century School Park coming up tomorrow.
Regarding the weekly report, on Thursday, July 23, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive which resulted in one arrest for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.

Today is the perfect day to enjoy a Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor from Culver's. You can also catch the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today between 11 AM and 4:30 PM or at the Verona Farmers Market from 3 PM until 6:30 PM.
